mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_run (id, tenant_id, owner_id, strategy_version_id, requested_trade_date, actual_trade_date, status, parameter_snapshot, data_source, data_freshness, universe_count, candidate_count, warnings, started_at, completed_at) values (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{ownerId}, #{strategyVersionId}, #{requestedTradeDate}, #{actualTradeDate}, #{status}, cast(#{parameterSnapshot} as jsonb), #{dataSource}, cast(#{dataFreshness} as jsonb), #{universeCount}, #{candidateCount}, cast(#{warnings} as jsonb), #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})

insert into cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_candidate (id, strategy_run_id, stock_code, stock_name, rank_no, score, reason_summary, snapshot) values (#{id}, #{strategyRunId}, #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{rankNo}, #{score}, #{reasonSummary}, cast(#{snapshot} as jsonb))

insert into cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_candidate_evidence (id, strategy_candidate_id, evidence_code, label, operator, expected_value, actual_value, matched) values (#{id}, #{strategyCandidateId}, #{evidenceCode}, #{label}, #{operator}, cast(#{expectedValue} as jsonb), cast(#{actualValue} as jsonb), #{matched})
mapper.select: select r.id, r.tenant_id as tenantId, r.owner_id as ownerId, r.strategy_version_id as strategyVersionId, r.requested_trade_date as requestedTradeDate, r.actual_trade_date as actualTradeDate, r.status, r.data_source as dataSource, r.universe_count as universeCount, r.candidate_count as candidateCount, r.warnings, r.completed_at as completedAt, v.version_no as strategyVersionNo, d.strategy_code as strategyCode from cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_run r join cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_version v on v.id = r.strategy_version_id join cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_definition d on d.id = v.strategy_definition_id where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.owner_id = #{ownerId} and d.strategy_code = #{strategyCode} and r.deleted_at is null and r.status in ('SUCCEEDED', 'NO_DATA') order by r.completed_at desc nulls last, r.created_at desc limit 1
